text: Curious, Amaterasu peeked out at her own radiance in the mirror, and that mirror became the first of the three sacred treasures of Japan's emperors.
spoken: Curious, Ah-mah-teh-rah-soo peeked out at her own radiance in the mirror, and that mirror became the first of the three sacred treasures of Japan's emperors.

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
